scenes.title: Three facts about Korea

actions.target: the map of the Korean Peninsula
the Winter Landscape of Deogyusan Mtn. photo

scenes.narration: Three facts. One: about seventy-five percent of the peninsula is mountains. Two: four distinct seasons, and winter means it. Three: in 1443, King Sejong created Hangeul so ordinary people could read. Most teams can't agree on a font.
